sparql_tries.sparql:
SELECT DISTINCT ?modelName WHERE {
  ?k a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?kv ; rc:affectsComponent ?c .
  ?kv rc:ofModel ?km .
  ?km rc:name "TELLURIDE" ; rc:ofMake ?kmake .
  ?kmake rc:name "KIA" .
  ?c skos:broader ?parent .
  ?g a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?gv ; rc:affectsComponent ?c .
  ?gv rc:ofModel ?gm .
  ?gm rc:name ?modelName ; rc:ofMake ?gmake .
  ?gmake rc:name "GENESIS" .
} ORDER BY ?modelName

SELECT ?model ?modelName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?campaigns) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?model . ?model rc:name ?modelName . } GROUP BY ?model ?modelName ORDER BY DESC(?campaigns) LIMIT 1

SELECT ?campaign ?campaignNumber ?potentiallyAffected WHERE { ?campaign a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:parkOutside true ; rc:potentiallyAffected ?potentiallyAffected . OPTIONAL { ?campaign rc:campaignNumber ?campaignNumber } } ORDER BY DESC(?potentiallyAffected) LIMIT 1
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?count) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:initiatedBy ?i . FILTER(UCASE(STR(?i)) = "ODI") }

SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:reportReceivedDate ?d ; rc:filedBy ?m . ?m rc:name ?mn . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?mn), "HYUNDAI|KIA|GENESIS", "i")) BIND(YEAR(?d) AS ?year) } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1
